sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 492 was established by Ordinance No. 23364, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 10, 1997. Ordinance No. 23364 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 492 is established on property generally located at the northwest corner of Interstate Highway 30 and Westmoreland Road. The size of PD 492 is approximately 17.780 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Development/Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.104. DEVELOPMENT/LANDSCAPE PLAN.

(a) For a metal salvage facility and an outside salvage or reclamation use, use and development of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 492A).

(b) For all other permitted uses, a development plan must be approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of any building permit. Development and use of the Property must comply with the approved development plan. The development plan and any amendments must comply with this article.

(c) An amendment, other than a minor amendment as specified in Section 51A-4.702(h), to the development plan for a metal salvage facility and an outside salvage or reclamation use or to an approved plan as provided for in Subsection (b) above, is considered a change in zoning district classification and must follow the same procedures set out in Section 51A-4.702. [Note: The development plan is incorrectly stamped with Ordinance No. 23365, rather than Ordinance No. 23364.] (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Metal salvage facility.

(b) Outside salvage or reclamation.

(c) Except as provided above, the only uses permitted in this district are those uses permitted in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the IM Industrial District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code. For example, a use permitted in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District by specific use permit (SUP) only is permitted in this PD by SUP. A use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District is subject to DIR in this PD, etc. (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory community center (private). -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. -- Home occupation. -- Private stable.

(c) The accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator use is permitted by SUP only. [See Section 51A-4.217(3.1).] (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard.

(1) For a metal salvage facility and an outside salvage or reclamation use, minimum front yard is as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(2) For all other permitted uses, minimum front yard is 15 feet where adjacent to an expressway or a thoroughfare and no minimum in all other cases.

(b) Side and rear yard.

(1) For a metal salvage facility and an outside salvage or reclamation use, minimum side and rear yard is as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(2) For all other permitted uses, minimum side and rear yard is 30 feet where adjacent to or directly across an alley from an R, R(A), D, D(A), THE, THE(A), CH, MF, or MF(A) district and no minimum in all other cases.

(c) Dwelling unit density. No maximum dwelling unit density.

(d) Floor area ratio. For all uses, excluding a metal salvage facility and an outside salvage or reclamation use, maximum floor area ratio is:

(1) 0.5 for retail and personal service uses;

(2) 0.75 for any combination of lodging, office, and retail and personal service uses; and

(3) 2.0 for all uses combined.

(e) Floor area. For a metal salvage facility and an outside salvage or reclamation use, maximum permitted floor area is as shown and located on the development/landscape plan.

(f) Height.

(1) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. (See Section 51A-4.412.) Exception: Structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less.

(2) Maximum height. Unless further restricted under Paragraph (1), maximum structure height is 110 feet.

(g) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 80 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(h) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(i) Stories. Maximum number of stories is eight. Parking garages are exempt from this requirement, but must comply with the height regulations of Subsection (f). (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

For all permitted uses, consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Divisions 51A-4.300) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Ingress/Egress
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.110. INGRESS/EGRESS.

(a) Prior to the issuance of a building permit on the Property for development labelled as Phase II Expansion, the following improvements must be made:

(1) The existing driveway on Westmoreland Road must be modified to operate as a right-turn in and right-turn out only.

(2) The existing median opening on Westmoreland Road at the existing driveway must be closed.

(3) The existing median on Westmoreland Road must be modified to provide a northbound left turn lane at the proposed new driveway, which is located as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(b) Prior to reconstruction or modification of the improvements listed in Paragraphs (1), (2), and (3) above, plans for these improvements must be approved by the director of public works and transportation in accordance with city specifications. (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) For a metal salvage facility and an outside salvage or reclamation use, landscaping must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(b) For all other permitted uses, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(c) Prior to the issuance of a building permit for new construction on the Property, all applicable licenses for landscaping, location of trees, and pavement must be obtained.

(d) All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.114. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-492.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 492 is located on Zoning Map No. K-5. (Ord. Nos. 23364; 26042)
